item.description: From later this year, the new Chief Inspector of Hospitals, Professor Sir Mike Richards, will start a process of deep dive inspections that will give an expert peer-review insight into all aspects of how each of our NHS Trusts operate, with patient safety being one of the five core domains he will consider. item.description: And from 2014 onwards, we will have additional European financial instruments for equity finance and loan guarantees for innovative enterprises. [Partly checkable; Mixed claim]

item.description: The counter argument is that none of this will matter much – after a painful transition involving lots of problems – if, somehow, we can tap into growth elsewhere. [Partly checkable; Scenario (if… then)]

item.description: Those parents on low incomes will continue to get 70% of their childcare costs paid, through universal credit, so we will have a system where if you’re in a middle or a higher income you’ll get 20% of your costs, if you’re on a lower income you’ll get 70% of your costs paid.
